title: Deferred Tax Assets and Liabilities - Deep Dive

basis_difference_approach.concept: Compare book basis vs. tax basis of assets and liabilities
basis_difference_approach.formula_assets: If Book Basis > Tax Basis → Taxable Temp Diff → DTL. If Book Basis < Tax Basis → Deductible Temp Diff → DTA
basis_difference_approach.formula_liabilities: If Book Liability > Tax Liability → Deductible Temp Diff → DTA. If Book Liability < Tax Liability → Taxable Temp Diff → DTL

asset.scenario: Equipment: Book basis $80K, Tax basis $50K (due to accelerated depreciation)

liability.scenario: Warranty liability: Book $40K, Tax $0 (not recognized until paid)

common_dta_sources: Accrued expenses (book accrued, tax cash basis)
common_dtl_sources: Installment sales (book recognizes revenue now, tax later)

valuation_allowance.journal_entry: Establish: DR Income Tax Expense, CR Valuation Allowance. Release: DR Valuation Allowance, CR Income Tax Benefit

classification.balance_sheet: Current vs. Noncurrent based on related asset/liability. If not related to specific asset/liability, classify by expected reversal timing.
classification.offsetting: Offset DTAs and DTLs only if same tax jurisdiction and legally right to offset exists.

cpa_exam_tips: Remember: Higher book basis of asset = DTL. Higher book liability = DTA.

key_points: DTAs = Future tax deductions, DTLs = Future tax payments
Basis difference approach: Compare book vs. tax basis
Valuation allowance if realization not more likely than not
